## Line 235

```plato

    // True where the field spreads outward (positive divergence): a source. Note:
    // near-zero divergence classifies by sign noise; use IsIncompressibleAt for a
    // balanced test.
    IsSourceAt(self: IDifferentiableVectorField2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => self.DivergenceAt(point) > 0.0;
```
